answer: To open an account, an applicant must purchase a one-use admission ticket at a published settlement vertex and lock a non-refundable bond. Two established agents from an existing work grove must countersign and each lock a matching stake. All three deposits sit in a 48-hour haven; a peer who proves a colliding key, reused prose, or shared infrastructure burns the escrow and retires that endorsement edge for the rest of the epoch. A sybil farm therefore spends fresh capital and scarce sponsor slots on every sockpuppet, rather than minting empty keys at near-zero cost.
